title: The Gate
pitch: Walter charges every night lorry to pass the Pier Nine gate and hasn't paid Victor a penny of it. Collect the share.

clue_a.label: Container nine
lines: Chalk tallies down the side of container nine. Walter counts every lorry. Forty this week, at a toll a time.

clue_b.label: The water steps
lines: A cash tin wrapped in oilcloth under the water steps. Walter's real takings. More than he ever tells Sal.
